theorem compact_pair_observable_localization {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  (K U : Set X) (f g : X → ℝ) (hK : IsCompact K) (hU : IsOpen U)
  (hKU : K ⊆ U) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
  ∃ V W : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ closure V ⊆ W ∧
    IsOpen W ∧ IsCompact (closure W) ∧ closure W ⊆ U ∧
    IsCompact ((fun x => (f x, g x)) '' closure W) := by
  obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂_comp, hKL₂, hL₂U⟩ := exists_compact_between hK hU hKU
  set W := interior L₂
  have hW_open : IsOpen W := isOpen_interior
  have hKW : K ⊆ W := hKL₂
  have hW_comp : IsCompact (closure W) :=
    hL₂_comp.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure (closure_minimal interior_subset hL₂_comp.isClosed)
  have hWU : closure W ⊆ U :=
    (closure_minimal interior_subset hL₂_comp.isClosed).trans hL₂U
  obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁_comp, hKL₁, hL₁W⟩ := exists_compact_between hK hW_open hKW
  set V := interior L₁
  have hV_open : IsOpen V := isOpen_interior
  have hKV : K ⊆ V := hKL₁
  have hVW : closure V ⊆ W :=
    (closure_minimal interior_subset hL₁_comp.isClosed).trans hL₁W
  refine ⟨V, W, hV_open, hKV, hVW, hW_open, hW_comp, hWU, ?_⟩
  exact hW_comp.image (by continuity)
